AddressEmptyCode(address).details: There's no code at `target` (it is not a contract).

ERC1967InvalidImplementation(address).details: The `implementation` of the proxy is invalid.

ERC1967NonPayable().details: An upgrade function sees `msg.value > 0` that may be lost.

FailedInnerCall().details: A call to an address target failed. The target may have reverted.

OwnableInvalidOwner(address).details: The owner is not a valid owner account. (eg. `address(0)`)

OwnableUnauthorizedAccount(address).details: The caller account is not authorized to perform an operation.

UUPSUnauthorizedCallContext().details: The call is from an unauthorized context.

UUPSUnsupportedProxiableUUID(bytes32).details: The storage `slot` is unsupported as a UUID.

AuthorityUpdated(address).details: Authority that manages this contract was updated.

Initialized(uint64).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

Upgraded(address).details: Emitted when the implementation is upgraded.

batchGet(bytes32[]).details: Retrieves the addresses for a batch of contract names.

params._names: An array of contract names to query.

returns._0: address[] An array of addresses associated with the given names.

batchRegister(bytes32[],address[]).details: Registers multiple contract names and addresses in one transaction.

params._address: An array of Ethereum addresses of the contracts.
params._name: An array of contract names to register.

batchUpdate(bytes32[],address[]).details: Updates the addresses for multiple contract names in one transaction.

params._address: An array of new Ethereum addresses for the contracts.
params._name: An array of contract names to update.

get(bytes32).details: Retrieves the address associated with a given contract name.

params._id: The name of the contract to query.

returns._0: address The contract address associated with the given name.

isConsumingScheduledOp().details: Returns true only in the context of a delayed restricted call, at the moment that the scheduled operation is being consumed. Prevents denial of service for delayed restricted calls in the case that the contract performs attacker controlled calls.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

register(bytes32,address).details: Registers a new contract name and address.

params._address: The Ethereum address of the contract.
params._name: The name of the contract to register.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setAuthority(address).details: Transfers control to a new authority. The caller must be the current authority.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

update(bytes32,address).details: Updates the address for an existing contract name.

params._address: The new Ethereum address of the contract.
params._name: The name of the contract to update.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

batchRegister(bytes32[],address[]).notice: Skips any name that is already registered.

get(bytes32).notice: If the name is not registered, the function reverts with the NotFound error.

register(bytes32,address).notice: If the name is already registered, it returns true without modification.

update(bytes32,address).notice: If the name is not registered, it reverts with the NotFound error.
